objective: T-20260929-36 (autonomous-queue.md): recheck registry direction dir:nasdaq_long_short_event_router_1m. Its best route (lookback 10, entry after 2 bars, top 1, min relative volume 1, QQQ-prior-negative gate, opening_reversal, max opening return 0) reached research_pass on Alpaca IEX cache (sweep_002: full window 2024-05-31..2026-05-29 Sharpe 1.41, annualized 35.24 percent) but was never checked on consolidated SIP data. Run the identical route, no parameter change, on SIP 1-minute bars 2023-01..data end, with 10/20 bp per side costs, placebos and the S3 combination test, and decide kept / partial / refuted.

sources.core_claim: We also show that short-term return reversal is driven by temporary liquidity imbalances lasting less than an hour and bid-ask bounce.
sources.project_applicability: Mechanism prior for buying an opening loser: reversal from transient liquidity imbalance that decays within about an hour; the route enters 2 minutes after the open and holds to the close, so the effect window and the holding window differ.
sources.reflection: Motivates the router's opening-reversal selection and warns the edge is a liquidity-provision premium that is large in wide-spread illiquid tapes (IEX-only prints) and small at SIP quotes.

sources.core_claim: Individual stocks experience sharp intraday return reversals in the cross-section during the last 30 minutes of the trading day.
sources.project_applicability: Recent (2025) evidence that intraday losers get positive price pressure in the cross-section of U.S. stocks; our route holds the opening loser through that late-day window.
sources.reflection: Supports the sign of the route's exposure (long intraday losers) while showing the payoff is concentrated late in the day, not at the 09:32 entry.

sources.core_claim: Eleven families fail because gross return before friction is 0.07-1.50 points, below the 2.0-point friction floor.
sources.project_applicability: Negative prior: opening-window OHLCV rules on Nasdaq-100 products usually fail the friction and year-stability tests, so a pass here needs to survive both explicitly.
sources.reflection: Sets the bar for the router recheck: net-of-cost, out-of-window, year-stable, placebo-beating; it is the direct counter-prior for the IEX-derived research_pass.

sources.core_claim: Previous studies of the U.S. market regard short-term reversal as compensation for liquidity provision.
sources.project_applicability: Frames why a reversal premium can be earned by liquidity providers and is expected to shrink with spread and with tape coverage.
sources.reflection: Reversal returns are tied to liquidity provision, so they depend on how prints and fills are measured (IEX-only vs consolidated tape).

sources.core_claim: we dissect their returns into intraday and overnight com- ponents with respect to the U.S. market hours
sources.project_applicability: Supports evaluating the route as a pure intraday (open-to-close) return stream separate from overnight gaps, as the router does.
sources.reflection: Same-day flatten means the router earns no overnight return; its series must be compared with S3 on a same-session close-to-close convention.

sources.core_claim: accounts for approximately ~2.5% of the market volume
sources.project_applicability: The router's original research_pass used the IEX feed cache, which sees about 2.5% of volume; SIP is the consolidated tape (100% of volume).
sources.reflection: Explains why an opening-window rule (first two 1-minute bars, relative volume) can differ sharply between IEX-only and SIP tapes.

sources.core_claim: split : adjust price and volume for forward and reverse stock splits dividend : adjust price for cash dividends spin-off : adjust price for spin-offs all : apply all above adjustments
sources.project_applicability: Defines split-adjusted and dividend-adjusted prices, which matter for the 10-day prior-momentum and previous-close terms across the NVDA 2024-06-10, AVGO 2024-07-15 and NFLX 2025-11-17 splits.
sources.reflection: Adjusted-for-dividends prices change lookback returns by the dividend yield at most; splits must be adjusted or lookback returns break.

sources.core_claim: $0 locate and borrow fees on all ETB shares for Trading API users.
sources.project_applicability: Short borrow cost for easy-to-borrow mega-caps is $0 from the broker; the task still charges 0.5% a year (about 0.2 bp per short day) as a conservative modeled cost.
sources.reflection: Borrow cost is immaterial for a same-day-flatten intraday book; the binding shorting constraints are locates, Reg SHO and spreads.

candidate_matrix_revisions.effect: Added random-pick placebos (3 preregistered seeds plus 200 distribution seeds) and a year-by-window report to the candidate set, because the closest independent evidence says most OHLCV intraday rules fail friction and year stability.
Kept every parameter frozen and changed only the data tape (IEX cache to SIP consolidated), so any difference is attributable to the data; no local IEX minute cache exists to replay.
Added a split and dividend adjustment audit against data/sip/daily for NVDA (2024-06-10), AVGO (2024-07-15) and NFLX (2025-11-17) before trusting the 10-session prior momentum.
Modeled borrow at 0.5 percent a year on short trade days although the broker fee for easy-to-borrow names is $0, so the short leg is not flattered.
